summary: Checked 57 claims in 017-feat-wal-archiver-tech-spec.md against the tree at 41fb586; found 7 mirages, none critical. Every file the spec plans to modify exists, every named test exists with the exact value the spec states, all four showWAL sites are real, the Configure() `case "wal":` genuinely needs no edit, and every cited ADR / tech-debt number resolves. The defects are one false statement about TestViews_Configure's current content, one deliverable ("0.12.0 release notes") that has no artifact in the tree, a help.go edit the spec undercounts relative to its own research, and four imprecise file:line references.

findings.claim: tech-spec Task 5 says view_test.go's TestViews_Configure contains "matrix rows that pin the PG 19 `wal` column count changed in Wave 1", which the task must *update*.
findings.reality: internal/view/view_test.go:99-253 — TestViews_Configure asserts nothing about the `wal` view at any version. The `case 190000:` block (:183-192) and `case 140000:` block (:193-202) assert only progress_vacuum / progress_analyze / progress_basebackup; there is no `views["wal"]` reference anywhere in the file. The companion research (§10.G row 10) states this correctly: "no `wal` assertion at any version; add the wal assertions". Spec and research disagree.
findings.fix: Reword Task 5 to "add PG 19 / PG 18 `wal` Ncols+DiffIntvl assertions to TestViews_Configure" instead of "update the matrix rows that pin" — an executor told to update non-existent rows may conclude the work is already done and skip the assertion entirely.

findings.claim: Decision 13 and Task 9 make "the 0.12.0 release notes" a deliverable that "must name the literal failure text users will see"; Task 9's Files to modify is `docs/roadmap-0.12.0.md` and its verify step is "grep the release notes for both literal messages".
findings.reality: There is no 0.12.0 release-notes artifact in the tree. `doc/release-notes/` contains only `v0.8.0.md` and `v0.9.0.md` (nothing for 0.10.0 or 0.11.0), and `docs/roadmap-0.12.0.md:478` states the project's own policy: "Version bump — git-tag-driven via ldflags; no CHANGELOG (GoReleaser generates release notes)". `docs/roadmap-0.12.0.md` exists but is a planning roadmap, not release notes.
findings.source: 017-feat-wal-archiver-tech-spec.md, Decision 13 and Implementation Tasks Task 9; also Backward Compatibility ("Migration strategy") and the Risks table
findings.fix: Either name the concrete file the text goes into (e.g. a new `doc/release-notes/v0.12.0.md`, which would be a new practice given the GoReleaser policy) or say plainly that the breaking-change text is recorded in `docs/roadmap-0.12.0.md`. As written, Task 9's verify step does not identify which file to grep.

findings.claim: Architecture and Task 6 say the `top/` work touches "two help-screen lines (`top/help.go`)".
findings.reality: The research lists three edit sites in `top/help.go`: `:14` (`r,w  'r' replication, 'w' WAL,`), `:19` (the `j,J` line, model for a new `w,W` line) and `:45` (`('Q' does not reset shared stats: pg_stat_io, bgwriter, wal)`), noting at §10.A/:80 that the archiver is likewise not reset by `Q` and that line should gain `archiver`. All three lines are present in the tree as described. The spec's count of two silently drops the `Q`-caveat edit.
findings.source: 017-feat-wal-archiver-tech-spec.md, Architecture "What we're building/modifying" and Task 6 Description
findings.fix: Say "three help-screen lines" and name `help.go:45` explicitly, or state that the `Q`-caveat line is deliberately left alone.

findings.claim: Decision 12: "`report/report.go:315-320` discards the first sample unconditionally".
findings.reality: The discard is the block `if !prevStat.Valid || versionChanged {` at report/report.go:277, whose body assigns prevMeta/prevStat/prevTs at :278-280 and ends with `continue` at :319. Lines 315-318 belong to the `if versionChanged` sub-branch (`orderConfigured = false`, `v.OrderKey = seedOrderKey`, `v.OrderDesc = seedOrderDesc`) — unrelated to the first-sample drop. Only :319 falls inside the cited range. "Unconditionally" is also loose: the drop is conditional on `!prevStat.Valid` (the first sample) or a recorded-version change.
findings.fix: Cite `report/report.go:277-320` (condition at :277, `continue` at :319) and phrase it as "the first sample is always dropped because it has no predecessor".

findings.claim: Decision 2: the calculateDelta short-circuit was "verified by reading both call sites (`internal/stat/stat.go:440` for the TUI, `report/report.go:505` for the report)".
findings.reality: internal/stat/stat.go:440 is the comment line `// Compare previous and current Postgres stats snapshots and calculate delta.`; the actual `calculateDelta(...)` call is at :441. report/report.go:505 is `stat.Compare(curr, prev, interval, v.DiffIntvl, ...)` inside `countDiff` — not a call to `calculateDelta` but to the exported one-line wrapper `Compare` (internal/stat/postgres.go:575-577), which delegates to `calculateDelta`. The conclusion (the {0,0} short-circuit covers both paths) holds; the references are off.
findings.fix: Cite `internal/stat/stat.go:441` and `report/report.go:505 → stat.Compare → internal/stat/postgres.go:575-577 → calculateDelta`, so the indirection through `Compare` is visible.

findings.claim: Decision 3: rendering NULL as blank is "the same decision ADR [013] took for `backend_xid`".
findings.reality: The ADR at docs/decisions-log.md:872 is `[013-feat-activity-xmin-horizon] backend_xid kept as a raw column though only its presence matters` — its decision is "keep `backend_xid` as a raw catalog column rather than synthesising a boolean indicator", i.e. a column-choice decision, not a coalesce-vs-blank decision. It does contain the supporting observation "only blank-versus-set carries information", so the analogy is defensible, but the ADR did not decide anything about `coalesce`.
findings.fix: Reword to "consistent with ADR [013]'s reasoning that blank-versus-set is itself the signal"; the load-bearing precedent for the coalesce rule is patterns.md:46, which the spec already cites correctly.

findings.claim: Architecture: "`report/` — a describe entry and constant for the archiver screen ... `report/describe.go`, `report/report.go`" (Task 7 Files to modify).
findings.reality: Correct but worth pinning: the description constants live in `report/describe.go` (`pgStatWALDescription` at :141) while the map that Task 7 must extend is `describeReport` in `report/report.go:665-...` (the `"wal": pgStatWALDescription` entry is at report/report.go:674) — not in describe.go. The test to extend is `Test_describeReport` in report/report_test.go, whose `{report: "wal", want: pgStatWALDescription}` row is at :1183 (research §10.G says :1184).
findings.source: 017-feat-wal-archiver-tech-spec.md, Task 7 and Testing Strategy ("The describe map returns the new archiver description")
findings.fix: No change strictly required; optionally note in Task 7 that the constant goes to describe.go and the map entry to report.go:674, so both edits are explicit.
